heading_en: In-Scope Securities Financing Transactions under a Legally Effective Bilateral Netting Contract for Which the Credit Risk Mitigation Effect of Eligible Financial Collateral Cannot Be Taken into Account
summary_ja: 相対ネッティング契約下の対象証券金融取引について、ネッティング・セット単位で担保超過率が加重平均の標準的下限を下回る場合は適格金融資産担保を勘案しないことを定める。
summary_en: For netted in-scope SFTs, collateral is disregarded for the netting set if its over-collateralization ratio is below the netting-set-level haircut floor; the same applies under the expected exposure method.
paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach that uses the comprehensive approach shall, for in-scope securities financing transactions under a bilateral netting contract, where the value calculated for each netting set by the formula listed in item (i) is below the value calculated by the formula listed in item (ii), not use eligible financial collateral (limited to that listed in the table of paragraph (2) of the preceding Article) as a credit risk mitigation technique for that netting set. In this case, where the expected exposure method is used for those in-scope securities financing transactions, eligible financial collateral (limited to that listed in the table of that paragraph) shall not be taken into account in calculating the credit equivalent amount of the netting set. (i) {{F:p140i0}} ΣtCt is the total transaction amount of the securities or cash that are borrowed on a net position basis in the repo-style transactions and margin lending and similar overseas transactions included in the netting set (the same applies in the following item). ΣsEs is the total transaction amount of the securities or cash that are lent on a net position basis in the repo-style transactions and margin lending and similar overseas transactions included in the netting set (the same applies in the following item). (ii) {{F:p140i1}} E_{s} is the transaction amount of a specific security or cash that is lent on a net position basis in the repo-style transactions and margin lending and similar overseas transactions included in the netting set. f_{s} means the standard haircut floor provided in paragraph (2) of the preceding Article for the securities or cash that are lent on a net position basis in those transactions (provided that it is zero for cash or bonds of central governments, etc.). C_{t} is the transaction amount of a specific security or cash that is borrowed on a net position basis in those transactions. f_{t} means the standard haircut floor provided in paragraph (2) of the preceding Article for the securities or cash that are borrowed on a net position basis in those transactions (provided that it is zero for cash).

Where collateral has been called by a party to the transaction, that collateral may be taken into account in the formulas listed in the items of the preceding paragraph, regardless of the period until settlement.
